patched.notes: PAT-663: converted from method=static to method=resolved strategy=vendor-api. The source URL uses CloudFront hotlink protection that returns HTTP 403 without a Referer header from the enpass.io domain. vendor_api_referer set so the pipeline resolver sends the correct Referer, causing a 307 redirect to the versioned pkg URL at dl.enpass.io. Confirmed working 2026-07-04 — resolves to https://dl.enpass.io/stable/mac/package/6.12.3.2597/Enpass.pkg.
